Orca lets you build, discover, and play Minecraft games with friends.
Orca is a game launcher for Minecraft. Players browse games and experiences and join with one click, no mod installation, no setup. We handle hosting and mod delivery for server owners and game creators, who earn revenue from their games. Think Roblox, but built on top of Minecraft's 312M player base.

Orca (Simplifine) is an AI Minecraft mod maker and related game-creation tooling: describe a mod in plain English and Orca builds playable content, with free-to-start positioning for creators.
Public materials on orcaengine.ai / Orca Client emphasize crafting blocks, items, mobs, and full mods without coding, creator partnerships with large view counts, and GitHub/Simplifine-gamedev roots tying the Orca Engine brand to Simplifine.
Orca sells consumer/creator AI game-mod tooling.
The business model is freemium creator software for Minecraft/mod generation.
Public positioning emphasizes practical outcomes for customers rather than hype metrics alone, with product and company materials focused on durable workflows teams can adopt.
Company materials focus on concrete product workflows buyers can evaluate without relying on unverified metrics.
